text:
Ari B.: Need creative for "Serving Wins: Inference Economics" launch. Deliverables: webinar hero, blog hero, social teaser, three benchmark microtiles (latency / cost / reliability), and an inbound lead banner that supports A/B capture. Target ship: next Thursday EOD.
Nina V.: Got it. Can you confirm tone + two copy variants? and any hard legal lines?
Ari B.: Tonality: confident, nerdy-but-friendly. Copy Variant 1 (promo): 'Serving Wins: LLM inference that scales predictably.' Variant 2 (engineered): 'Runtime optimizations + smart routing = stable p99 latency and < $0.011 token economics.' Legal: include: 'Tests run on representative infra; results may vary.'
Carlos E.: For the microtiles, prefer compact data viz (sparkline + delta) versus iconography. Prioritize viz. Also provide exact export sizes.
Rina T.: Export spec request:
```
webinar_hero: 1600x900 png (retina @2x as 3200x1800)
blog_hero: 1200x675 jpg
social_teaser: 1200x628 png
microtile: 360x240 png (3 tiles)
banner_lead: 1200x250 png + 600x125 @2x
```
Include transparent PNG option for header overlays.
Ari B.: Also need an alternate webinar hero that uses a simple schematic showing routing fallback (hosted -> dedicated -> private) with arrows and labels. Make that second comp.
Nina V.: Understood. Anything about brand palette?
Ari B.: Use Brand Kit v3 primary palette only. No gradients. Type: Inter variable, regular/medium/semibold only. No condensed weights. Include standard logo lockup and clearspace.
Carlos E.: Microcopy for tiles (short):
- Latency: 'p50 28ms (tuned) vs 135ms (baseline)'
- Cost: 'token cost down to $0.010 vs $0.017'
- Reliability: '99.95% uptime with fallbacks'
Also add small footnote: 'Measurements on A100-ish workloads; sample workloads only.'
Rina T.: Can ops provide tracking params for the banner CTAs? Need final UTM before export.
Ari B.: @ops please drop UTM: utm_source=serving_wins&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=bench_launch_v2
creative-bot: Ticket CR-7290 created (assignee: Nina V., due: 2026-02-12).
Nina V.: I'll drop initial frames into Figma tonight: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/serving-wins-assets. I'll add comments containing alt-text drafts and aria labels.
Carlos E.: For accessibility, suggest alt-text examples: 'Bar and sparkline comparing tuned vs baseline latency' + short description for each tile. Nina plz paste into figma copy.
Rina T.: QA note: QA wants copy locked 24 hours before final export to allow legal and accessibility signoff.
Ari B.: Good call. Add a small A/B variant on the banner CTA copy: 'Get the benchmark' vs 'Download bench pack'. We'll test which converts better.
Nina V.: Comps ETA: first pass by Tue morning, polished by Wed. Will upload export zip to the ticket when ready.
Ari B.: Thanks all. Ping here when uploads complete, and include export checklist (file formats, retina, alt-text, utm). :party_parrot:
